description: Ryba-Wieloryb, the gigantic whale-fish of Slavic fairy tales on whose back the world rests, a huge dark grey-blue whale, one wide chunky shape filling the whole picture, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, a small village of wooden huts and green trees standing on its back, barnacles on its skin, a huge eye, its mouth open, its tail raised high to strike, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the whale alone, no water, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole whale inside the picture, the tail too
